name: Jan (Łoś) Goliński

events.type: Recorded a life estate for Anna Bojanowska, widow of Władysław Otto-Trąmpczyński, in their second marriage

events.note: The regest of 1671 has their mutual life-interest settlement, she already his wife.

notes: Jan Łoś Goliński, son of Stefan, burgrave of Konin; the database's two entries, Jan Goliński (dw.34113) and Jan Łoś-Goliński (sw.33416), are one man (the editor, 2026-11-13). By Anna Bojanowska, widow of Władysław Otto-Trąmpczyński, father of Paweł and Apollonia; by Konstancja Krusińska, father of Teresa, the wife of Krzysztof Prusimski. Which marriage came first is not settled: Anna was his wife by 1671 and is still called Golińska in 1698, and Konstancja, later Kałowska, was alive in 1706.
